gloss: momentum; impetus; bounce; spur of the moment

definitions.explanation: The force or energy that keeps something moving forward or accelerating. Used for both physical and figurative momentum.

definitions.gloss: impulse; spur of the moment; chance occurrence
definitions.explanation: An unplanned action triggered by a sudden impulse or coincidence. Often used with に or で to mean 'on impulse' or 'by chance.'

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}に{弾|はず}みがつく。
{成功|せいこう}が{弾|はず}みとなって、{次|つぎ}のプロジェクトも{順調|じゅんちょう}に{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: The success served as momentum, and the next project also progressed smoothly.

examples.japanese: この{勝利|しょうり}をチームの{弾|はず}みにしたい。
examples.english: I want to use this victory as a springboard for the team.

examples.japanese: {弾|はず}みで{言|い}ってしまった。
examples.english: I blurted it out on impulse.

examples.japanese: {酒|さけ}の{弾|はず}みで{余計|よけい}なことを{話|はな}した。
examples.english: Carried away by the drink, I said things I shouldn't have.

examples.japanese: ぶつかった{弾|はず}みに{持|も}っていたコップを{落|お}としてしまった。
examples.english: When I bumped into something, the impact made me drop the cup I was holding.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {弾|はず}む (to bounce, to spring). The core image is of a bouncing, springing force — something that propels forward or triggers an action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弾|はず}みがつく: to gain momentum
- {弾|はず}みをつける: to build up momentum
- {弾|はず}みで: on impulse; by the force of
- {弾|はず}みとなる: to serve as a springboard
- {酒|さけ}の{弾|はず}みで: carried away by drink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勢|いきお}い: vigor, force, momentum (broader; can describe ongoing energy)
- {衝動|しょうどう}: impulse, urge (stronger emotional drive, often for sense 2)
- きっかけ: trigger, opportunity (emphasizes the starting point rather than the force)
